title.zh: Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework
title.en: Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework

current_state.zh: Australia released draft legislation to implement the OECD's Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework, creating domestic crypto tax reporting obligations and enabling automatic exchange of crypto tax data with 76 other committed jurisdictions from 2028, with public comment open until Oct. 28.
current_state.en: Australia released draft legislation to implement the OECD's Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework, creating domestic crypto tax reporting obligations and enabling automatic exchange of crypto tax data with 76 other committed jurisdictions from 2028, with public comment open until Oct. 28.
